_note: Slow-moving reference data. Review weekly, not daily.

kitchen.statusText: ₹111.21/L — REVISION RISK RISING: BRENT ~$90, 3RD SESSION ABOVE $85
kitchen.twoWeek: Under-recovery widening at Brent $86; next hike risk if $85+ sustains 2 weeks
kitchen.detail: Brent's climb from $73 to ~$86 in ten days has re-opened OMC under-recovery. No hike announced yet, but a sustained $85+ Brent plus rupee at 96+ (imported-cost double hit) makes an August revision increasingly likely. Every Rs 1/L = Rs 12,000 Cr annual consumer burden.

kitchen.statusText: ₹97.83/L — TRUCKING AND FOOD LOGISTICS COSTS RISING WITH CRUDE
kitchen.twoWeek: Watch Brent $85+ persistence — diesel hike would hit food logistics into festive season
kitchen.detail: Diesel at ₹97.83 after the July revision. June WPI at 9.87% already shows food and non-food transmission; sustained Brent above $85 would compound it. Every ₹1/L = ₹2,500 Cr annual trucking cost.

kitchen.statusText: CUSTOMS DUTY HIKED — Gold +Rs 9,000 in one session
kitchen.twoWeek: Wedding and festival demand curtailed. Forex conservation measure.
kitchen.detail: Modi government raised gold customs duty days after PM's appeal to avoid gold purchases for weddings for one year. Gold jumped Rs 9,000 in one session. Dual measure: voluntary appeal + fiscal enforcement. Rs 3-4L Cr annual gold import bill targeted.

kitchen.statusText: ₹942.00 — WATCH: HORMUZ TERMS TIGHTEN GULF LPG SUPPLY
kitchen.twoWeek: Commercial supply at ~70%; renewed Hormuz disruption is the key risk
kitchen.detail: Fitch flagged Rs 30,000-35,000 Cr government subsidy payout for LPG losses ALONE. Commercial LPG constrained — restaurants, hotels, industrial users operating at reduced capacity.

kitchen.statusText: CRITICAL — Modi urged 50% reduction, switch to natural farming
kitchen.twoWeek: WPI 9.87% confirms food-price transmission; kharif top-dressing window is the pressure point
kitchen.detail: Modi urged farmers to reduce chemical fertiliser by 50%. Araghchi BRICS Delhi Thursday = Jaishankar can negotiate coordinated Gulf fertiliser import corridor directly with Iranian FM.

nukes.name: Bushehr ☢️
nukes.info: IAEA: strikes 250ft from operating reactor. Rosatom evacuated 200 staff. Reactor operational. IAEA cannot access. Minor explosions in Tehran suggest continuing instability. Ceasefire holding but Iran reconstituting missile bases — escalation risk if Apr 21 ceasefire lapses.

nukes.name: Natanz
nukes.info: MAIN enrichment plant 75% damaged. R&D 95% destroyed. Nuclear sticking point — Vance offered 20-yr moratorium, Iran said 3-5 yrs, both rejected. IAEA: Iran has ~1,000 lbs (440kg+) HEU = enough for ~11 nuclear weapons. Fox News: 'all ingredients of a deal' — suggests nuclear gap may be bridgeable.

nukes.name: Isfahan
nukes.info: CRITICAL: IAEA Grossi: MAJORITY of Iran's ~440kg of 60% HEU in deeply buried tunnel complex here. US demanded retrieval at Islamabad; Iran agreed only to 'monitored down-blending' — rejected by US. UCF conversion 90% destroyed above-ground. New underground enrichment facility — IAEA never inspected.

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Fordow built into mountain near Qom. Only 30% damaged despite GBU-57 MOPs. Core enrichment capability potentially intact. US demanded full dismantlement; Iran refused at Islamabad. Greatest long-term proliferation risk. Iran reconstituting missile cities during ceasefire — same pattern expected here.

nukes.name: Arak (IR-40)
nukes.info: Heavy water reactor capable of producing weapons-grade plutonium. Struck in early war waves. Satellite imagery showing Iran reconstituting missile cities during ceasefire — Arak likely same pattern. Second potential weapons path alongside uranium enrichment.

Rajasthan wind funnel. Kharif fertiliser at risk if Hormuz closed through May. Diesel freight costs elevated at Brent $112. OMC hike imminent.
Southern Naval Command + Op Urja Suraksha base. Oil spill risk 15-25 days. Fishing economy ₹4,000 cr exposed. Iran Red Sea threat hits western coast shipping routes near Kochi. Insurance 10x pre-war.
Konkan coast. Fishing economy Rs 4,000 Cr exposed. Tourism under pressure with Brent $112+. ATF surcharges active on all airline routes.

Indo-Gangetic plain trap. Food inflation risk from fertilizer disruption — structural even post-deal. CNG vehicle users benefiting from rupee strengthening. IMF recession risk warning dampens consumption outlook.

East coast currents provide nuclear buffer. IT sector led today's rally — Infosys, HCLTech major gainers. Wipro Q4 results tomorrow Apr 16. Auto sector (Maruti/Hyundai) also recovering. Port active for alternative routes.

featured.title: The Strait of Hormuz and the New Logic of Chokepoint Control
featured.desc: Chokepoint control is no longer binary (open/closed) but a layered spatial contest spanning seabed topology, island sovereignty, electronic warfare, and visibility asymmetry. The cartography of maritime control in the 2026 crisis.

featured.title: Geopolitics of LPG Supply in India
featured.desc: How India's LPG import dependency on the Gulf creates acute vulnerability during the West Asia War. Explores Hormuz exposure, alternative supply routes, and policy imperatives for energy security in a blockade scenario.

featured.title: Geopolitics of Fertiliser Supply in India
featured.desc: India imports 30%+ of its fertilisers via the Strait of Hormuz. This paper maps the supply chain risks to kharif and rabi crops, the strategic case for diversification, and what a prolonged blockade means for food security.
